closure_policy.closed: Mapped commit verified in history AND every mapped proof suite resolves to a registered assets/development-test-registry.json entry or an in-repo verifier/runner script; the remediation is demonstrable entirely within the repository.
closure_policy.custody-deferred: Local remediation tooling verified as above, but the finding asserts a fact about an environment this repository/workstation cannot produce (hosted GitHub Actions exact-head runs, installed-host receipts); recorded honestly instead of claiming closure.
closure_policy.open: A mapped commit is absent, a mapped proof suite cannot be resolved to any registry entry or script, or verification otherwise fails.
